gen-gf-phudu-gf-inclusive-sans: Round letters whose rims match their stems, with curves left open at the ends, give the text a contemporary feel. Inclusive Sans sits beneath Phudu's bold headings, and both keep a pressure-free, ballpoint-plain line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-kanchenjunga: Distinctive is the first word for Phudu, whose curves have generous terminal openings and a pressure-free ballpoint line. Kanchenjunga then brings shapes that never clog at low resolution, traced with a technical drafting pen's steady line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-mingzat: Mingzat's curvy letters feel pleasantly unclamped. Phudu's bold headings never vary their line width in any letter, while Mingzat's gentle low contrast loosens the text beneath them.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-niramit: Niramit has letter curves that look like they are gaping, giving its text a clean, professional openness. Phudu's bold, distinctive headings keep their line width through every curve and turn.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohingy: Approachable and modern, Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya shows a visibly gaping c at any size. But Phudu's marker-nib line ignores direction altogether, so the bold headings feel blunt above the gentler text.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Bold, unbroken lines: Phudu never changes width on any letter, over Noto Sans Linear A's clean text with its visibly gaping c. Reading it feels unfussy, with nothing to snag on.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Linear B sends a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend. Phudu supplies the bold, distinctive side, its pencil-line consistency running through every heading on the page.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Phudu's diagonals carry the weight of its verticals, bold and distinctive. Noto Sans Manichaean meets it with modern, clean text whose e crossbars have open mouths and a low contrast.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Noto Sans Mongolian reads neutral and modern, with terminals that flare outward. But Phudu's headings feel a bit like laser-cut sheet, one stroke width throughout, bold against the flared text.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Approachable describes Noto Sans NKo Unjoined, with wide openings on its small letters. And Phudu's strokes never pinch at the curves, so the bold headings stay smooth over the low-contrast text.
